title: How is Elvis connected to Obama?
description: Four real photos connect Elvis Presley to Barack Obama.
hook: How is Elvis Presley connected to Barack Obama?

links.line: In December 1970, Elvis showed up at the White House and asked Richard Nixon to make him a federal drug agent.

image.file: File:Mr. and Mrs. Ford and Nixon 13 Oct 1973.jpg

links.line: In 1973, Nixon picked Gerald Ford as his vice president. Less than a year later, Ford had Nixon's job.

image.file: File:President Clinton with former presidents George H. W. Bush, Gerald Ford, and Jimmy Carter wave from the stage at the dedication of the George H. W. Bush Presidential Library at Texa - DPLA - 34dd2e1f15a119c9c93c3b2c42c179f0.jpg

links.line: In 1997, Ford shared a stage with President Bill Clinton at the opening of a presidential library in Texas.
And in 2013, Barack Obama hung the Presidential Medal of Freedom around Clinton's neck.
